purpose: Teach: 如何なる/原著/生い立ち/懇願/物言い/卵子/破局/公道

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、如何なる困難も学術で克服した事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, in your paper you examined how academic study has overcome various hardships — cases and precedents.
lines.style: Warm, observant opening. Slight lean forward. Genuine interest in the student's work. Unhurried pace, clear enunciation. The tone of a teacher who reads what students submit.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、海外哲学書の原著翻訳の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched the original foreign philosophy texts and their translation in my paper.
lines.style: Quiet, focused response. Slight uplift at the start. Steady eye contact. The careful precision of someone stating what she actually did, not performing for the teacher.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文豪の生い立ちの伝記研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And in another paper, you examined biographical research on a literary figure's origins and early life.
lines.style: Gentle confirmation, not interrogation. Pause before speaking, as if reviewing her own notes. Warm recognition. The rhythm of someone genuinely reflecting on a student's growth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、災害支援を懇願する自治体の声明を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on local government statements requesting disaster relief support.
lines.style: Clear, matter-of-fact. No hesitation. The same precision as before but slightly more grounded — this topic is closer to real consequence.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統的相撲の物言いの研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you also studied the language and ritual objections used in traditional sumo wrestling.
lines.style: Warmth with a hint of quiet amusement. Pacing slows slightly — this is one she's genuinely curious about. The teacher who notices the range in a student's interests.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、不妊治療と卵子凍結の倫理研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my research covered the ethical questions surrounding fertility treatment and egg freezing.
lines.style: Steady voice. No apology, no overexplanation. This topic has weight and she meets it directly. The slightest softening at the end, like she's being honest about why this matters.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 終戦時の社会の破局的状況の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your last paper examined the catastrophic social conditions at the end of the war.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. This is heavier material. She speaks with respect for the subject. Pause held at the end — not trailing off, but marking the gravity of what was studied.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、公道での自動運転実験の倫理を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I studied the ethics of autonomous vehicle testing on public roads.
lines.style: Final answer with quiet conviction. No performance. The same earnest precision held all the way through. A small breath at the very end, as if closing one conversation before the next begins.
